description: Most recent FIFA world ranking of the home team before the match date.
Most recent FIFA world ranking of the away team before the match date.
FIFA ranking points of the home team at the most recent ranking release before the match.
FIFA ranking points of the away team at the most recent ranking release before the match.
home_rank minus away_rank. Negative = home team is ranked higher (better). Key predictor of match outcome.
home_fifa_pts minus away_fifa_pts. Positive = home team has more points.
Elo rating of the home team immediately before this match (computed chronologically from all prior results in the dataset). K-factor scales with tournament importance and margin of victory.
Elo rating of the away team immediately before this match.
home_elo minus away_elo. Strong continuous predictor of win probability. An Elo difference of 200 implies ~75% win probability for the stronger team.
Average points per game for the home team in their last 5 matches before this one (3=win, 1=draw, 0=loss). Captures recent momentum.
Same as home_form5 for the away team.
Average points per game in last 10 matches. Smooths out variance vs form5.
Same as home_form10 for away team.
